interpretation: A separate mechanism control retaining the first ablation. Submit the same 4+4 jobs in both variants; move the midpoint completion drain to the end. Overlap and the resulting worker assignment can change. One worker executes identical code across all three labels.
decision: For attribution at 4 workers require both blocks to pass timing and controls. At 1 worker also require one_join/reference to satisfy control bounds. A pass does not reopen the first candidate's adoption gate.
